title: OpenCode harness profile
description: Everything that changes when you change model. Plugins read this file and contain no model names of their own.

id.description: Slug used as the profile filename and the oc-harness use argument.

provider.description: opencode provider id, e.g. opencode, opencode-go, anthropic.

model.description: Model id without the provider prefix, e.g. space-bunny-free.

family.description: Model family for grouping. Stealth models report null upstream, so this may be set by hand.

verified.description: ISO date a human checked this profile against live metadata.

retention.description: Must match an entry in retention.yml. A profile whose model is unknown there cannot become the default.

limits.description: Token ceilings from the provider catalog. `input` is absent for several Zen models, in which case the loader derives it from `context`.

supports.description: Capability flags. Missing or false means do not emit the related config.

attachment.description: Accepts image or video input. Gates screenshot-based verification.

effort.description: Available reasoning levels, lowest to highest. Empty means the model has no tunable effort.

reserveShare.description: Share of the input ceiling held back for reasoning and tool output growth.

roles.description: Requested effort per agent role. Resolved against effort.levels, never emitted raw.

roleModels.description: Model per agent role, for a profile that splits the heavy reasoning roles onto a stronger model while the bulk-output roles stay on a high-output one. `model` remains the base: roles not named here, the top-level `model`, and `small_model` all resolve to it.

prune.description: Deterministic context pruning. Only used when a model-driven compressor is unavailable or unproven.

keepRecentToolCalls.description: Verbatim tool outputs kept at the tail.

keepRecentTurns.description: Trailing turns whose text and reasoning stay verbatim.

keepUserMessages.description: Never stub a user message. Their instructions are the point of the session.

fallback.description: Ordered profile ids to fall back to. Selection happens at session start, not mid-session: no opencode plugin hook can change a live session's model.

roleModel.description: A model for one role, plus the effort levels that model actually offers. Required when the model differs from the base, because a level the model does not have must never be written onto the agent.

model.description: Model id without the provider prefix. Must resolve to a profile in this directory, so its limits and retention are known.

levels.description: Effort levels this role's model offers. Omitted means the role emits no variant at all, which is the right reading for a model with no tunable effort.

oneOf.description: Desired level, resolved to the nearest available one.
This role should not set a variant at all.
